title: Kobra Data API Envelopes
description: Normative request and response shapes for the launcher's save/config/mod API (spec Section 8, Appendix C). The browser never names a filesystem path: every target is a validated identifier, and the server builds the path (FR-API-4). Error responses MUST NOT leak absolute paths.

identifier.description: A slot, config key prefix, or mod id. MUST be lowercase ASCII and MUST NOT contain a path separator, a dot segment, a drive letter, or a UNC prefix (FR-API-4). The server rejects anything else with 400 bad_identifier.

error.description: Error envelope (Appendix C.4). 'message' is user-presentable and MUST contain no filesystem paths, no OS username, and no stack trace.

state.description: GET /api/state. The shell checks api_version compatibility (FR-API-12) and data_writable to decide between normal and In-Memory Session mode (FR-SAVE-18).

data_writable.description: Result of the startup write probe (FR-SAVE-16). False means read-only or noexec media: saves are held in server memory for this session only (FR-SAVE-18).

data_dir_kind.description: 'override' means --data-dir was used, so saves do not travel with the game folder (FR-SAVE-19).

writer.description: Session id currently holding the writer role, or null. Used for single-writer election across tabs (FR-SHELL-3).

heartbeat_interval_seconds.description: FR-SRV-18. The client-side heartbeat cadence the shell uses while the page is visible; a hidden page uses six times this value. Published so server.heartbeat_interval_seconds is not inert.

corrupt.description: True when the slot failed validation and only a .bak is loadable (Section 11.6).

saveList.description: GET /api/data/saves. Must be correct even when data/saves/index.json is missing; rebuilt_index reports that the index was reconstructed (Section 11.3).

if_revision.description: Optimistic-concurrency token. If it does not match the current revision the server returns 409 conflict (FR-SAVE-9). Omit only for a deliberate unconditional overwrite.

claim.description: Request the cross-tab writer role (FR-SHELL-3). Returns 409 if another session holds it.

payload.description: Engine-defined state. Unknown fields MUST be preserved on rewrite (FR-SAVE-4).

thumbnail.description: Relative path within data/, never absolute.

conflict.description: 409 response to a stale if_revision. The shell MUST present overwrite / save-as-new-slot / cancel, defaulting to a new slot (FR-SAVE-10).

configWrite.description: POST /api/config. Merge-write of top-level keys; the server MUST preserve keys the request does not mention.

mods.description: GET /api/data/config/mods. Enabling or disabling a mod reloads the overlay at next boot (FR-AST-13).

missing_dependency.description: Set when the mod is disabled because a required mod is absent (mod manifest 'requires').

modAction.description: POST /api/mod. 'install' is for user-supplied archives only; the game itself never downloads mods (offline-first, Section 1.3).

session.description: POST /__kobra/session body. The token arrives via the URL fragment and is single-use with a 120 s TTL (FR-SRV-7, FR-API-13).

sessionResult.description: Session exchange response. csrf_token is also set as a non-HttpOnly cookie; writes must echo it in X-Kobra-CSRF (FR-SRV-6a).

probe.description: GET /__kobra/probe. Unauthenticated and deliberately opaque: no filesystem path, no OS username, no game folder location (FR-SRV-9). Used for free-port detection and same-game-already-running detection (Section 6.3).
